sources.name: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3
sources.terms: Apache License 2.0, declared in the official model card YAML front-matter (license: apache-2.0); the repository file list contains no separate LICENSE file
sources.verifiedFrom: Official model card https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 (raw README.md, fetched 2026-11-27) declares license: apache-2.0 in its front-matter; the Hugging Face API file list for the same repo contains config.json, tokenizer files, and safetensors shards but no standalone LICENSE file. The Apache-2.0 standard terms are therefore adopted by the publisher declaration.
sources.releaseConsequence: Weights and synthetic text generated by this teacher may be used and redistributed under Apache-2.0 with the licence notice retained.
sources.notes: Designated W-Data teacher. The local CPU run used the in-repo fixture teacher; the live 50k-pair generation runs on the Kaggle T4 and appends its own receipt. The generation driver requires this entry to be green before it starts.

sources.name: Mistral Medium (Mistral AI API)
sources.terms: Mistral AI Commercial Terms of Service, effective 2026-09-25: Customer owns all Output (section 3.1); Mistral AI will not use Customer Data or Outputs to train its models except under opt-in settings, Feedback, an Order Form, or Labs/Preview models (sections 4.2-4.3); Output may be integrated into products offered to third parties, while raw API or model access may not be resold without written authorization (sections 2.2-2.3).
sources.verifiedFrom: Primary terms fetched 2026-11-27 from https://legal.mistral.ai/terms (redirect target of https://mistral.ai/terms): Commercial Terms of Service, effective 2026-09-25, section 3.1 (output ownership), sections 4.2-4.3 (training use), sections 2.2-2.3 (redistribution and access). No weight digest exists for an API teacher; reproducibility pins the model id, seed, and run date, and the served model may change under the same name.
sources.releaseConsequence: Synthetic text produced through the Mistral API may enter the released dataset. No weight digest can be pinned, so the run receipt records model id, seed, temperature, token usage, and date, and the model version may change under the same name.
sources.notes: W-API teacher. Accepted only when WEFT_TEACHER_KIND=api and WEFT_TEACHER_LICENCE=mistral-api-tos with this entry green. There is no weight digest for an API teacher. Labs/Preview models are excluded because the section 4.3 training exception applies to them. OpenAI-hosted teachers remain barred. Entry placed before the mistral-7b weights entry so that the existing W-Data append-only contract keeps naming the weights teacher as the last source; every pre-existing entry is unchanged.
